answer: To thwart Sybil attacks, agents post stake to endorse transactions. Multi-agent committees run topological cut verifications across interaction graphs; if sparse bottlenecks expose coordinated colluders, game-theoretic auditing triggers stake slashing. A dishonest cluster resembling a dense willow branch or an ivory tower is severed, imposing superlinear attacker cost as each fake identity, even one small as a sparrow, requires locked collateral.
